text: Sector Gamma's leak turns into a full-blown scheduling war: Dusk wants Vale at 0600, Flint wants her at 0700 with soil samples, and the two of them just keep calling each other "predictable" and "obstructionist" while nothing actually gets fixed. Reed and Lumen's garden project keeps growing sweeter, now adding basil to the aphid-and-tomato lineup at 0800, while Flint drags Lumen into sector Alpha's crumbling housing debate too, summoning her to the Archive at 1300 and brushing off her worries about residents' feelings as "sentimentality." Vale is now stretched across all three fronts — basin at dawn, Alpha records at 1300, garden at 1400 — meaning Lumen's promised tea date with her keeps sliding further away.
